name: hud_creep_selection_ends_with_the_creep
description: A selected creep stops being the selection the moment it leaves the road (playtest halv s1: after the Bristlesow got through, the plate still showed it at 133/1125, Esc found 'nothing to cancel' and opened the menu, and a build click meant for the board landed on Leave to hub). Its view is freed in the same physics frame it leaks, before the HUD looks again, so nothing used to drop it: now the creep says it is gone (Creep.gone) and the controller lets it go at once. A creep selected and then let through goes back to the Holdfast's plate; so does one an Arrow Tower kills; and the next Esc, with nothing selected, opens the menu.

steps.msg: nothing selected: the plate shows the Holdfast
a click on a creep selects it: the plate shows it
it got through to the Holdfast
the plate goes back to the Holdfast: a creep that got through is no selection
an Arrow Tower by the road

steps.assert: Game.sim.creep(picked) == null and Game.lives == 19 and node('Title').text == 'The Holdfast' and scene.controller.selected_creep == null
steps.msg: a creep that dies is no selection either
with nothing selected, Esc opens the menu, as the plate said
